description: Trigger evals for inventory-snapshot: it fires when the upstream Figma component library should be listed into figma_components.md with coverage and a delta versus the last run, while design-spec-review, design-bootstrap, foundation-audit and component-spec handle one component review, first-time setup, token drift, and a single component spec.

should_trigger: design pushed a library update to Figma yesterday. Refresh the component list and tell me what changed since the last one.
seed the Figma component inventory for the new project, I want to see which components already have a spec, code or story
Can you go through the upstream Figma library and write docs/research/_inventory/figma_components.md with tier, node id and whether we've built each one?
what components did the designers add or remove in Figma since our last snapshot?
New quarter, new library version from design. Re-list every component with its node ID and mark the gaps on our side.

should_not_trigger.prompt: The Chip component was built last week. Does its code match the Chip spec for the selected, disabled and focus states?
Brand new project with a Figma file and nothing else. Extract the variables, set up the foundations folder and scaffold the design system.
Design renamed a batch of color variables in the Figma library. Compare them with the tokens in our theme file and the foundation docs and list every mismatch.
Write the full spec for the Tabs component from its Figma node, anatomy, sizes, states and accessibility.
List every component file under packages/ui in our code, ranked by how much the rest of the app imports it, with exported signatures, so the assistant can find things fast.
